messages:
Priya: Hey all — quick ask: can we shift the weekly triage call 30m earlier (from 11:00 -> 10:30 PT) starting next week? APAC on-call overlap improved if we move, and it frees up a post-lunch window for some folks.
Jordan: +1 for APAC coverage. 10:30 is better for me.
Alex: Slight :+1: — only concern is Deep Dives on Fridays, some folks use the 11:00 slot for async reviews. Can we keep Fridays unchanged?
Priya: Good point. Proposal: move Mon-Thu to 10:30, keep Fri at 11:00 for the longer deep-dive.
Sofia: Works for me. Also want to propose a tiny agenda tweak: split the 30m into two lanes in parallel — (1) bug queue owners do quick triage, (2) infra/oncall handle incidents and rollout blockers. Saves time and reduces context-switching.
Dina: I like the parallel lane idea if we have clear owners. Maybe rotate the bug-lane owner weekly.
Sam: Agree. Also add a 5-min slot at the end for unblock requests that need follow-up so we don't derail the main agenda.
Priya: Draft agenda (30m):
```
- 0-12m: Bug queue lane (owner-led quick claims + PR pings)
- 0-12m: Infra lane (oncall + rollout blockers)
- 12-22m: Hotfixes / regressions (combined sync if overlap)
- 22-27m: Action item assignment + calendar notes
- 27-30m: Quick unblock/async follow-ups (if needed)
```
Jordan: Could we make the bug lane preroll include a short list in the doc so owners arrive ready? I can add a sorted bug list automatically from the tracker.
Priya: Yes please. Jordan — can you add a script that posts top-10 bugs to the doc every morning? If not, a manual pinned list will do.
Jordan: I'll try to wire the script this week. If not ready, I'll maintain the list manually on Mon/Tue.
Alex: For rotation, propose owners: Week A = Alex, Sofia; Week B = Dina, Priya — rotate Monday morning. Keep a two-person handoff so someone can cover.
Sofia: Fine by me. I'll update the calendar description with the owner for each week.
Dina: One more ask: add a short checklist in the calendar invite for owners (claim, assign, PR ping, ETA).
Priya: Will add checklist and update invites after Jordan confirms the bug-list automation.
eng-oncall-bot: NOTE: calendar invite for "eng weekly triage" updated to 10:30 PT Mon-Thu, 11:00 PT Fri. Recurrence updated.
Sam: :thumbsup: thanks. Can we also add a short note on how to escalate to oncall during the call? New engineers keep asking.
Priya: Good call — will add a 1-line escalation pointer in the invite and doc.
Jordan: I'll post a sample script and the tracker link in the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/triage-bug-list
Priya: Awesome. Final decision: change Mon-Thu -> 10:30 PT, Fri stays 11:00 PT; implement parallel lanes and rotation; add 5-min unblock slot. If anyone strongly objects please reply by EOD, otherwise I'll update the invites and agenda doc.
Dina: No objections from me.
Alex: Fine.
Sofia: Good to go.
Priya: Thanks everyone — will follow up with updated invite + checklist + doc link.
Jordan: And I'll aim to have the auto-post script by Thursday. If not, manual update on Monday.
Priya: Cabook: @calendar "eng weekly triage" updated. See doc for owner rotation.
eng-oncall-bot: Reaction added :white_check_mark: to message by Priya.
